# Plan Review Checklist: UI redesign — Screens v2 and Design System v2

**Purpose**: Test the quality of the feature 002 plan and its frozen contract before the `review-plan` gate: constitution compliance, contract completeness, spec ↔ plan traceability and scenario coverage.
**Created**: 2026-09-23
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [research.md](../research.md) · [data-model.md](../data-model.md) · [contracts/openapi-delta.yaml](../contracts/openapi-delta.yaml) · [quickstart.md](../quickstart.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Constitution Alignment

- [x] CHK001 - Does the plan say how the `LedgerService.balanceSeries` default `from` ("earliest entry date of the returned accounts") reaches `AccountsService` through a public ledger method, given that `accounts` may not read `EntriesRepository`? [Gap, Principle VII, Research R-002]
- [x] CHK002 - Is the rule for where ceilings are recorded consistent between the constitution ("marked in code with a comment") and CLAUDE.md ("never in the code, only in Complexity Tracking"), and does the plan state which one the `toPlotNumber` entry follows? [Conflict, Constitution §Workflow, Plan §Complexity Tracking]
- [x] CHK003 - Are the ceilings named in research (10-year span clamp, sequential `ILIKE` with no index, one query per account, 180-point downsample, palette `limit=8`) recorded in plan.md Complexity Tracking, where CLAUDE.md says ceilings belong? [Gap, Research R-001, R-002, R-007]
- [x] CHK004 - Is the Principle II exception for `toPlotNumber` bounded tightly enough: is it stated that no other cents → `number` conversion (count-up, donut share, morph interpolation) is allowed? [Clarity, Plan §Complexity Tracking, Research R-007]
- [x] CHK005 - Does the plan name a domain unit test for the active-only `total` aggregation, or is that rule, which decides the headline figure, covered only by e2e? [Coverage, Principle VI, Research R-012]
- [x] CHK006 - Is the Principle V split clear: which balance-history rules (date format, `from ≤ to`, 10-year span) the DTO rejects, and which a service raises as a typed domain error? [Clarity, Plan §Constitution Check V]

## Contract Completeness (openapi-delta 1.1.0)

- [x] CHK007 - Does the contract define how `q` combines with the existing filters (account, category, project, kind, date range): AND, or ignored? [Gap, Contract §QueryParam]
- [x] CHK008 - Is the claim that the endpoint without `q` "is byte-for-byte what it is today" reconciled with `forbidNonWhitelisted: true`, which today rejects `?q=` with 400? Is that change acknowledged under FR-020? [Consistency, Research R-001, Spec §FR-020]
- [x] CHK009 - Does the contract specify whether `to` may be in the future, given that the spec allows only "any past date" for Balance as of? [Gap, Contract §/accounts/balance-history, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK010 - Is the parsing of `includeArchived` defined for values other than `true`/`false` (for example `1` or empty), and does it match what `listAccounts` already does? [Clarity, Contract §/accounts/balance-history]
- [x] CHK011 - Is the default `from` defined when `includeArchived=true` and only archived accounts hold the earliest entries? Does their history widen the active total's range? [Edge Case, Contract §from]
- [x] CHK012 - Is the `/ai/status` tag (`reports`) consistent with its owning module (`ai`) and with how feature 001 tags the narrative endpoint? [Consistency, Contract §/ai/status, Research R-004]
- [x] CHK013 - Does the delta's description ("Three read-only additions") match its numbered list of four items, and is "applied verbatim" defined for a fragment that needs insertion at named positions? [Clarity, Contract §info.description, Research R-003]
- [x] CHK014 - Does `BalanceHistoryResponse` carry enough to render a card (name, kind), or does the plan state how the client joins it with `listAccounts` and keeps both consistent when the archived toggle changes? [Gap, Contract §AccountBalanceSeries, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK015 - Is a response-size limit set for "All" over 10 years × N accounts (about 3 650 strings per account), and is SC-006 checked against it? [Non-Functional, Contract §BalanceHistoryResponse, Spec §SC-006]

## Spec ↔ Plan Traceability

- [x] CHK016 - Are screens 06 (New transaction) and 08 (Loading) mapped to a story in the plan's Story → scope table, as the other 18 are? [Gap, Plan §Story → scope, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK017 - Does the plan define the mapping of the "20 design screens onto the 10 existing routes plus 3 overlays" explicitly, screen by screen? [Completeness, Plan §Technical Context]
- [x] CHK018 - Is the branch name consistent between spec (`002-ui-redesign-v3`) and plan (`002-ui-redesign`)? [Conflict, Spec header, Plan header]
- [x] CHK019 - Is the sidebar shell (FR-005) in Foundational consistent with US1 being the story whose Independent Test checks the grouped sidebar? [Consistency, Plan §Story → scope, Spec §US1]
- [x] CHK020 - Does the plan state what the tab bar's "More" item contains, so that "the tab bar reaches every primary route" (Categories, Similar, Projection, Projects) can be traced? [Gap, Spec §US7 scenario 1, Research R-010]
- [x] CHK021 - Does the plan state how a palette transaction row gets its account and category names, given that `TransactionResponse` carries only ids? [Gap, Spec §US5 Independent Test, Research R-009]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK022 - Is the mapping from each range (7D, 30D, 90D, 1Y) to `from` stated exactly (for 30D, is `from` equal to `to − 29` or `to − 30`)? [Ambiguity, Data model §Dashboard range, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK023 - Is "change since the start of the range" defined as `total[i] − total[0]` (end of day `from`) or relative to the balance before `from`? The two differ by the first day's movements. [Ambiguity, Spec §US2 scenario 1, Data model §Chart selection]
- [x] CHK024 - Is the donut share's rounding rule (truncating `× 1000n /` compared with half-up) defined, and is it stated whether shares must add up to 100.0%? [Clarity, Research R-007, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK025 - Is the 35% swipe threshold in the plan traced back to the spec's unquantified "a threshold", and does it hold for right swipes as well as left? [Clarity, Research R-010, Spec §US7]
- [x] CHK026 - Does the plan state whether SVG geometry constants (viewBox size, chart padding, stroke widths) count as the "hard-coded size" SC-004 forbids, given that `check:tokens` only sees `px` literals? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-004, Research R-005]
- [x] CHK027 - Is the `1px` hairline exception in `check:tokens` recorded as an intended exception to SC-004 rather than only in the script rules? [Consistency, Research R-005, Spec §SC-004]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK028 - Is the behaviour defined when the Undo `DELETE` fails, for example with an error toast carrying the correlation id, or with the Undo toast staying open? [Gap, Exception Flow, Spec §FR-017, Data model §State transitions]
- [x] CHK029 - Is the behaviour defined for two creates within 5 s: are there stacked Undo toasts, and which transaction does ⌘Z target? [Gap, Spec §FR-017]
- [x] CHK030 - Is the behaviour defined when the just-created transaction is edited, or deleted by swipe, during its Undo window? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §US6]
- [x] CHK031 - Is double activation (Undo button and ⌘Z, or two presses) defined so that no second `DELETE` is sent? [Edge Case, Gap, Research R-008]
- [x] CHK032 - Is focus return defined for palette → Enter → edit modal → close: does focus go to the palette's opener, and does the palette reopen? [Gap, Spec §US5 scenario 2, Research R-009]
- [x] CHK033 - Is the day used for "Overdue" and the Upcoming horizons (browser `localToday`) reconciled with the server's `APP_TIMEZONE` today used by the dashboard, for users whose zones differ? [Consistency, Research R-011, Research R-002]
- [x] CHK034 - Under reduced motion, is the 2.4 s row highlight defined as shown without animation or removed entirely, given that `--dur-flash` is zeroed? [Ambiguity, Research R-005, Spec §US6]
- [x] CHK035 - Is the Tailwind fallback's trigger defined (who decides, by when, on what failure), and does the plan state whether that switch needs a plan amendment? [Assumption, Research R-013]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK036 - Is the ARIA role for the chart consistent with its keyboard interaction? A focusable `role="img"` that takes arrow keys does not match its role. [Consistency, Accessibility, Research R-007, Spec §FR-019]
- [x] CHK037 - Does the contrast check cover SC-003 as written ("every text/background pair in the implemented screens"), or only the pairs listed in `design-system.md`, with nothing that proves the list is complete? [Coverage, Research R-005, Spec §SC-003]
- [x] CHK038 - Is SC-006 "usable within 2 seconds" measurable by something other than a manual DevTools check, and is "usable" defined? [Measurability, Quickstart §10, Spec §SC-006]
- [x] CHK039 - Does SC-001's "no mismatch" have an objective acceptance method beyond a side-by-side review by hand? [Measurability, Quickstart §13, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK040 - Is sampling some chart days in `redesign-dashboard` enough evidence for SC-005's "every value … over every range", together with the unit-level equality test, and does the plan say so? [Traceability, Research R-012, Spec §SC-005]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK041 - Is the scope order against the 2026-09-25 deadline consistent: Foundational ships `q` (needed only by US5) and `/ai/status` (US4) even though US5–7 slip first? Is it stated that `q` may ship with no consumer? [Assumption, Plan §Story → scope, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK042 - Are the Tailwind pins (4.3.3), the Vite 8 and TS 7 compatibility claim, and "no runtime JS" stated as verified rather than assumed? [Assumption, Research R-013]
